title: THE HOLLOW CROWN TAVERN (flash dogfood, pressure 2: trigger 14, thresholds -2)
room: The Hollow Crown is a low-beamed tavern on the king's road, half-empty since the old king died, lit by one hearth and too few candles. An iron circlet the locals call the Hollow Crown hangs on the mantel above the fire, and the innkeeper's ledger lies open on the bar beside the last good cask in the house. Snow has closed the road until dawn, when the tax collector is due, and no one can leave before then.

objects.name: The Hollow Crown
objects.effect: iron circlet on the mantel; the holder claims the old king's line

objects.name: Maud's Ledger
objects.effect: the debt book, including an entry 'forty crowns from I.M., for the circlet'

personas.name: Maud Ashgrove
personas.register: Innkeeper. Clipped, practical, counts everything aloud in coins and candles, never wastes a word on feelings.
personas.want: Collect every open tab before the tax collector arrives at dawn, or lose the inn.
personas.secret: The crown on the mantel is a forgery; she sold the real Hollow Crown months ago to pay last year's tax.
personas.tell: and that's the sum of it

personas.name: Pell Quickfinger
personas.register: Cutpurse bard. Quick, flippant, half-sung, rhymes when cornered, deflects every hard question with a joke.
personas.want: Tear out the ledger page that records his debt and his name.
personas.secret: He sells tavern gossip to the tax collector; the dawn visit is his doing.
